{{Quote|The Human has been inside the Sanctum of the Exalted. He's beyond weapons now.|Borjak, about Zayne Carrick|<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 30">[[Knights of the Old Republic 30|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 30]]</ref>}}
The '''Sanctum of the Exalted''' was the holiest place on the planet [[Odryn]], where the dead elders of the [[Feeorin/Legends|Feeorin]] were believed to reside, forging Odryn's seasons. Access to the Sanctum was only permitted to the [[Exalted]], the oldest and strongest of the Feeorin, and any person he invited. Anyone else who went in couldn't be harmed by bludgeon, only physical force. This changed, however, when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Feln]] was the Exalted. A member of a secret cabal known as the [[Jedi Covenant]], Feln opened up the Sanctum to the Covenant so they could use it for storage and study of ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith artifact/Legends|artifacts]], even though other Feeorin were not permitted to enter. The artifacts, such as [[Ludo Kressh's pedicure set]], were encased in a [[nullification resin]] to prevent their corruption from escaping. All such artifacts were marked with [[Covenant identichip]]s to display information on what they were.
[[File:Sanctum_of_the_Exalted.png|thumb|left|200px|The interior chamber of the Sanctum]]
In [[3963 BBY]], [[Jarael]], [[Dob Moomo|Dob]] and [[Del Moomo]], [[Zayne Carrick]] and [[Marn Hierogryph]] infiltrated the Sanctum in an attempt to uncover evidence of the Jedi Covenant's wrongdoing and take this evidence to the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]]. Carrick and Hierogryph discovered that the [[Helm of Dathka Graush|Helm]] of [[Dathka Graush/Legends|Dathka Graush]] was being tested on in the Sanctum, influencing weather in a six kilometer radius of the site. Considering this to be the evidence they needed, Carrick and Hierogryph left the Sanctum but were apprehended by the Feeorin shortly afterward.

In order to prevent the Covenant from being exposed, Jedi Master [[Lucien Draay]] ordered Feln to execute [[Option Ossus]], the destruction of the Sanctum, during a hologram meeting between the two of them following the capture of Carrick.

Feln later blew the charges in the Sanctum, destroying both it and the nearby village. In retaliation, [[Borjak]] led the other Feeorins, and killed Feln.
